text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'll give it my all in 
wrestling practice!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe-chan. You're looking even more 
fired up than usual today.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAAHHH!!! When Spe-chan's fired 
up, I get fired up tooooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Actually, it's not that I'm 
burning up, I want to burn things down—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What should I wear~♪ Oh, I know! I'll go 
with that skirt!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Huh, wait? My stomach... No, that 
can't be... Huuuuuh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so... it feels like I've really got to 
psych myself up for this...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that what happened...? But don't be 
down! Big Sis will help you out, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!? M-Maruzen-san, what is this... !?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a belly-jiggling machine! Just let it 
shake your tummy, and you'll transform 
into a totally groovy babe too♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We've also got a chin-up bar, a twirling 
stick, and a rodeo machine ready, so give 
them a try!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen any of these before! Is 
this the latest equipment? It looks super 
effective!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. The zipper wouldn't go up...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if even the vibration machine is 
giving up, we're in trouble...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan! In that case, wrestling training 
is definitely the way to go!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wrestling takes core strength to withstand 
your opponent's attacks—in other words, 
core stability is everything!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why we train our core— it raises 
our basal metabolic rate, making it much 
easier to burn energy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! I don't really get the complicated 
stuff, but in short, that means it'll help 
with dieting!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So let's do our best at wrestling! 
And that'll solve our chubby tummies 
toooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: P-Please don't call my tummy pudgy~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
99, 100! Still going, still going! 101! 
102! Let's hit three hundreeed!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
103, 104! T-Ticket-san! My core is 
freaking out!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Spe-chan! I've got delicious 
nata de coco chilled and waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...*sniff*, WOOOOOOOO!! You did it, 
Spe-channn!!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you so much for the guidance! 
With this, the skirt should definitely be— 
I'll go give it a try right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah!? Now I've put on muscle, and my 
skirt won't fit~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, Special Week showed the 
fruits of her training later on, and went 
on to achieve quite impressive results in 
wrestling...
